**Commute comparison: Stratford vs Bow to Liverpool Street**

Both areas have real, measured commute times from the TfL Journey Planner, so I can compare them directly.

**Stratford: 20 minutes each way**
- Walk to Stratford station (6 min) -> Greater Anglia to Liverpool Street (7 min) -> walk to the office (7 min)
- No changes required

**Bow: 29 minutes each way**
- Walk to Bow Road station (13 min) -> District line to Mile End (2 min) -> Central line to Liverpool Street (6 min) -> walk to the office (7 min)
- One change required

**Time saved by choosing Stratford (the faster option)**

Stratford is 9 minutes faster per single journey (29 minus 20 = 9 minutes).

- Per day: 18 minutes (9 minutes each way, times 2)
- Per week: 54 minutes (18 minutes times 3 office days)
- Per month: roughly 3 hours 36 minutes, based on 4 weeks (54 minutes times 4 = 216 minutes). If you prefer a calendar-month estimate, it scales with however many office days fall in that month.

**Practical notes**

- The Bow route involves a change at Mile End and a longer walk to the station (13 minutes vs 6), which matters more in bad weather or when carrying things.
- Stratford's advantage comes from the fast Greater Anglia service with no interchange.
- These are area reference-point journeys, not door-to-door times for a specific home, so an individual listing could shift the picture.

**Rent**

The data I have covers Bow only: cached listings range from 1650 to 4050 per month, with a median of 2350 (30 listings, cache about 89 days old, mixed room types, not live-verified). Stratford was not evaluated for rent in these results, so I cannot compare prices between the two — the search results don't cover Stratford rent. **Bottom line:** If commute time is your priority, Stratford saves you 18 minutes a day, 54 minutes a week, and about 3 hours 36 minutes a month across your 3 office days — with the bonus of a simpler, change-free route.
